_comment: Motion-quality penalty weights of the base reward (koth/env.py default_cfg). Each term is weight * value * control dt per step; a rung may still override them, and train.py --reward k=v overrides both. joint_torque (sum of actuator force squared) was added on 2026-11-20 and no shipped brain was trained with it: changing a weight here affects only the next training run, never the ONNX brains in Assets/_Project/RL_Models.
